New training: 100 versus 200 epochs

Dongxiao | Ethanol CCSD(T) | Gold-only | Validation-only comparison

Completed training: 200/200 epochs

Selected epoch: 200. Energy MAE increased by 11.1%; force component MAE decreased by 26.6%. This is a trade-off under the original joint validation criterion.

Report finalized October 1, 2026. Supersedes the September 24 snapshot at epoch 144.

Energy: kcal/mol. Force: Cartesian components, kcal/mol/Å. Both checkpoints were selected using validation energy MSE + 100 × force component MSE. Positive reduction means lower error; negative reduction means higher error.

What this establishes

A controlled comparison of training budgets for this seed and molecule. No new test score was produced. This does not establish multi-seed robustness or convergence.

The two runs share the same first 100 epochs and are not independent seed replicates. The selected epoch is at the budget limit, so convergence is not established. Earlier test diagnostics were already inspected; future evaluation on that same set must be disclosed as follow-up evaluation.
